name: RW03-B6 Excel control and close-out
description: RW03-B6 (RW03 real-world test). Brings every child's results together for the 10 invoice dossiers, reconciles counts and EUR totals, sorts variances into buckets, builds the control workbook with formulas and a pivot table, checks the formulas read back, stores it in the QA SharePoint site, scans every output for the secret canary and confirms no posted or paid documents.

variables.name: status
variables.description: success when every record was handled (routed exceptions included).

variables.name: result_file
variables.description: CSV file with one row per record.

It works through 10 invoice dossiers and writes its results to the run's output folder.
